copy.html:
Welcome to Our New Incentive Program!

Deposit, Spin, and Win Big with Amazing Prizes!

How It Works

Earn bonuses and free spins based on the amount you spend or deposit from your payment card. And you get this benefit not once, not twice, but for your first three qualifying transactions.

Spend a minimum of just €5 to qualify for the program.

The more you spend, the bigger the rewards!

What Are the Rewards?

The first three times that you spend or deposit more than €5 you will earn a double whammy of bonuses: a percentage of your initial spend will get added to your Reward Balance AND you will qualify for a number of Free Spins on our amazing Prize Wheel.

The percentage of your initial spend that will be returned as rewards grows with each qualifying deposit - starting at a generous 10% and climbing to 20% on the next, ending up at an absolutely massive 30% on the third qualifying transaction. The percentages and number of spins per qualifying tier are layed out in this handy table:

SPEND LEVEL BONUS PERCENT ON FIRST, SECOND OR THIRD QUALIFICATION SPINS AWARDED ON FIRST, SECOND OR THIRD QUALIFICATION
€5 to €10 10%, 20% or 30% 1 FREE SPIN
€10 to €40 10%, 20% or 30% 2 FREE SPINS
€40 to €100 10%, 20% or 30% 3 FREE SPINS
Over €100 10%, 20% or 30% 5 FREE SPINS

It's up to you how much you spend but as you can see, the more you spend the bigger the reward. There's up to 15 Free Spins waiting to be claimed, and a huge chunk of Reward Balance to boot.

Bonus funds are automatically credited to your Rewards Balance and free spins are shown in a special section of your account.

What Are the Prizes?

Currently there are over a dozen different prizes that can be won on the spin to win. The list changes from time to time so be sure to come back and check

The current list of Spin to Win Prizes:

  • Free entry into our Jackpot Prize Pool draw
  • Free tickets in the MegaMillions Lottery
  • Free tickets in the Australian Saturday Lottery
  • Free tickets in the EuroMillions Lottery
  • Free tickets in the US Powerball Lottery
  • Free tickets in the Irish Lotto
  • Free tickets in the French Lotto
  • Free entry into various lottery syndicates, not available for general sale
  • Additional 10% to Rewards Balance on top of the automatic qualification tier amount
  • Additional spins on the wheel
  • Discount on your next purchase

Spin to Win with LottosOnline.com

Simply put, it pays to go large with LottosOnline. The bigger your play on your first three card transactions, the more you reap the rewards!

It's easy to get player rewards at LottosOnline. We want to help our players get the best opportunity of winning jackpot prizes

So what are you waiting for? Stop dreaming, and start playing!

Start Playing!
